title: 2015 Golf R

source.name: Volkswagen maintenance schedule
source.note: Read from Volkswagen's USA maintenance schedule for the Golf R, in Glovebox's wording. Check it against the maintenance booklet that came with your own car.
source.basis: The mileages and jobs of Volkswagen's own USA maintenance schedule for the Golf R, as filed with NHTSA, for a car the owner maintains. Only those facts are taken; jobs are named in Glovebox's words and no text or layout is copied.

allWheelDriveOnly: Change Haldex clutch oil, every 3 years (AWD)
manualExcluded: Change DSG transmission fluid and filter (DSG only)
